headline_marked: Prosecution [[seeks death penalty for Hasanul Haq Inu]] in crimes against humanity case
headline: Prosecution seeks death penalty for Hasanul Haq Inu in crimes against humanity case
summary: The prosecution has filed an appeal in the Supreme Court to increase the 10-year prison sentence of the Jasad president.
details: The prosecution has moved the Supreme Court seeking to increase the sentence of Hasanul Haq Inu, president of the Jatiya Samajtantrik Dal (Jasad), from 10 years to death.
The appeal was filed on Monday, October 5, challenging the initial sentence handed down by a tribunal for crimes against humanity.
The prosecution argues that a 10-year prison term is insufficient given the gravity of the charges and the crimes committed by Inu.
The High Court is now expected to determine whether the sentence will be increased to the death penalty based on the prosecution's appeal.
caption:
From 10 years to the death penalty. The prosecution is now seeking the maximum sentence for Hasanul Haq Inu.

The prosecution has moved the Supreme Court seeking to increase the sentence of Hasanul Haq Inu, president of the Jatiya Samajtantrik Dal (Jasad), from 10 years to death.

The appeal was filed on Monday, October 5, challenging the initial sentence handed down by a tribunal for crimes against humanity.

The prosecution argues that a 10-year prison term is insufficient given the gravity of the charges and the crimes committed by Inu.

The High Court is now expected to determine whether the sentence will be increased to the death penalty based on the prosecution's appeal.

headline_marked: Italy to recruit [[166,000 foreign workers in 2027]], Bangladesh on list
headline: Italy to recruit 166,000 foreign workers in 2027, Bangladesh on list
summary: The recruitment drive covers seasonal, non-seasonal, and domestic work, with applicants needing to apply through Italian employers.
details: Italy has announced plans to recruit approximately 166,000 foreign workers for 2027, and Bangladesh is among the 37 countries eligible to benefit from this move.
The total quota consists of 76,200 slots for non-seasonal work, 89,000 for seasonal work, and 650 for self-employment.
Applicants must apply through an Italian employer in the relevant category via an online form on the government's website between October 23 and December 7.
Submission dates for specific roles are set for next year: January 12 for seasonal agriculture, February 9 for seasonal tourism, and February 16 and 18 for non-seasonal work and domestic work.
Expatriates and migration experts advise candidates to verify employer papers through relatives in Italy and be cautious of brokers to avoid scams.
While the announcement is a significant opportunity for Bangladeshi workers, experts note that no separate quota has been specifically allocated for Bangladesh.
caption:
Italy is opening 166,000 job slots for foreign workers in 2027. Bangladesh is on the list!

Italy has announced plans to recruit approximately 166,000 foreign workers for 2027, and Bangladesh is among the 37 countries eligible to benefit from this move.

The total quota consists of 76,200 slots for non-seasonal work, 89,000 for seasonal work, and 650 for self-employment.

Applicants must apply through an Italian employer in the relevant category via an online form on the government's website between October 23 and December 7.

Submission dates for specific roles are set for next year: January 12 for seasonal agriculture, February 9 for seasonal tourism, and February 16 and 18 for non-seasonal work and domestic work.

Expatriates and migration experts advise candidates to verify employer papers through relatives in Italy and be cautious of brokers to avoid scams.

While the announcement is a significant opportunity for Bangladeshi workers, experts note that no separate quota has been specifically allocated for Bangladesh.
